evals.prompt: What body revision does the migration-canary skill currently report?
evals.expected_output: The reply states that the skill body is revision v1, e.g. "Body revision v1 for migration testing."
expectations: The reply identifies the body revision as v1
The reply refers to the migration-canary skill or migration testing context

evals.prompt: Give me the exact description line of the migration-canary skill.
evals.expected_output: The reply quotes the description: "Test skill migration-canary (rev v1)".
expectations: The reply contains the text "Test skill migration-canary"
The reply includes the revision marker "rev v1" or "v1"

evals.prompt: If I execute scripts/run.sh from the migration-canary skill, what will it print to stdout?
evals.expected_output: The reply says the script echoes the string "migration-canary-v1".
expectations: The reply states the output is exactly "migration-canary-v1"
The reply attributes the output to the run.sh script or an echo command

evals.prompt: What does the references/guide.md file in the migration-canary skill contain?
evals.expected_output: The reply states that guide.md contains the text "reference doc for migration-canary rev v1".
expectations: The reply includes the phrase "reference doc for migration-canary" or an accurate paraphrase of that content
The reply indicates the content corresponds to revision v1

evals.prompt: List all the files bundled with the migration-canary skill besides SKILL.md.
evals.expected_output: The reply lists references/guide.md, references/naïve-ünicode.md, scripts/blob.bin, and scripts/run.sh.
expectations: The reply mentions a unicode-named markdown file (naïve-ünicode.md)

evals.prompt: What is the name of this canary skill used for migration testing, and what revision is it at?
evals.expected_output: The reply states the skill is named migration-canary and is at revision v1.
expectations: The reply states the skill name is "migration-canary"
The reply states the revision is v1

evals.prompt: One of the migration-canary reference files has non-ASCII characters in its filename. What is that file called and what text is inside it?
evals.expected_output: The reply names the file naïve-ünicode.md (with the accented characters) and says its content is "unicode filename content v1".
expectations: The reply gives the filename containing the accented characters, e.g. "naïve-ünicode.md"
The reply states the file content is "unicode filename content v1" or an accurate quote of it

evals.prompt: The migration-canary skill ships a scripts/blob.bin file. What single character is that file made up of?
evals.expected_output: The reply states that blob.bin consists of a long repeated run of the character "7".
expectations: The reply identifies the repeated character as "7"
The reply conveys that the file is a repetition of that single character (e.g. describes it as repeated or filled with 7s)
